Suspended against Santos, left-back Guilherme Arana returns to the side. Meanwhile, Alisson, Matheus Reis and Cano (in transition) and John Kennedy (injured) are the absentees for the night.

Savarino is favourite for one of the wide positions, while veteran Hulk is hoping for better luck against Palmeiras’s trio of centre-backs.

Palmeiras possible starting lineup: [...] Wednesday night will reveal the first finalist of the 2026 Copa Libertadores, with Palmeiras and Fluminense battling for a place in the showpiece, as the hosts defend the slender advantage earned with a 2-1 victory at the Maracana.

Verdao head into the second leg on the back of an impressive away win over Athletico, while the Tricolor from Laranjeiras rested several first-team regulars before suffering a comeback defeat to Neymar's Santos.

## Match preview [...] Last week at the Maracana, there was a moment when a more emphatic result could have been built, but Fabio prevented the worst with at least three fine saves. In stoppage time, Wesley Nata kept the Tricolor’s hopes alive. The 45-year-old goalkeeper also prevented a disaster on Sunday against Santos.

## Santos v Palmeiras: title chase meets Sudamericana push

Santos host Palmeiras in the Brasileirão on Wednesday, 28 October 2026 at Estádio Urbano Caldeira, with the visitors pursuing leaders Flamengo and the hosts aiming to consolidate their Copa Sudamericana berth. [...] Santos are without Neymar through suspension, while Lucas Veríssimo, Gonzalo Escobar and goalkeeper Gabriel Brazão are listed as injured. For Palmeiras, forwards Paulinho and Vitor Roque are injured and Jefté is suspended. [...] A home win would lift Alvinegro Praiano to 49 points and could edge them closer to the Copa Libertadores places. Victory would take Palestra to 72 points and could move them top, or at least tighten the title race behind Flamengo.
